readingText: Current River at Van Buren is running Good at 2.6 ft, a steady read over the past 24 hours. Discharge sits at 786 cfs, which is below the median for this date but well within the floatable band. The upper sections from Montauk to Akers will feel shallower than the lower reaches, so expect some line picking through riffles and light scraping on gravel bars if you're running a raft. A forecast trace of rain today will have minimal impact given the large spring base flow buffering light precipitation. With clear skies and dry conditions through Tuesday, the gauge should hold stable or drift slightly lower, making this a good window for a float. Always scout with local outfitters before launch to check for any recent strainers or blowdowns along your chosen section.
